paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the standard deviation of perplexity (on a logarithmic scale) across different layers of a model, under the condition that only Pyramid Value Caches (PvCs) are reserved at each layer. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” is linear and spans from 0 to approximately 35, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity (log) Std,” is also linear, ranging from 0.00 to 1.75, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. A single orange line with diamond-shaped markers shows a sharp decline in perplexity standard deviation from layer 0 (approximately 1.8) to layer 2 (approximately 0.3), followed by a gradual decrease to around 0.1 by layer 10, and then stabilizes near 0.0 across layers 20 to 35, with minor fluctuations close to zero. The gridlines are dashed and light gray, aiding in visual alignment of data points.
